notes: Metro token or Podorozhnik card (~70 RUB); the metro is deep. Pulkovo Airport: Moskovskaya metro plus bus 39. Use the Yandex Go app for taxis.

Winter brings -5 to -15°C and 6 hours of daylight; museums are quiet, the Neva is frozen, and there are New Year decorations from December to January. In autumn, September to October, the parks turn gold.

Visa: Turkish citizens get 60 days visa-free; others need an e-visa. Visa/Mastercard DO NOT WORK (since 2022), so bring cash RUB or Mir/UnionPay. A Turkish Ziraat card sometimes works, but bring cash.

Hermitage 1,000 RUB (timed, online), Catherine Palace 2,200, Peterhof park 1,500 plus palace 2,000, Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood 550. Closed days: Hermitage and Peterhof on Mondays, the Savior on Spilled Blood and St Isaac's on Wednesdays, the Russian Museum on Tuesdays.
Borscht, pelmeni, blini, pyshki. Business lunch (biznes-lanch) 12:00-16:00 costs ~500 RUB; tip 10%.
Keep your passport on you; hotels handle registration (registratsiya). Yandex Maps is more accurate than Google Maps.

stops.name: Nevsky Prospekt
stops.tips: A 4.5 km main boulevard. Look out for the Kazan Cathedral colonnade and the Singer building (Dom Knigi bookshop).

stops.name: Kazan Cathedral
stops.tips: A colonnade modelled on St Peter's. Free entry; Kutuzov's tomb is inside.

stops.name: Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood
stops.tips: A Russian-style church with 7,000 m² of mosaics, built where Alexander II was assassinated. Closed Wednesdays; buy tickets online.

stops.name: Pyshechnaya Bolshaya Konyushennaya
stops.tips: A Soviet pyshki (ring doughnut) shop since 1958. Expect a queue; cash only.

stops.name: Russian Museum
stops.tips: The largest collection of Russian art, with Repin and Aivazovsky's The Ninth Wave. Closed Tuesdays.

backups.name: Stolle Pirogi Nevsky
backups.tips: Russian pies (pirogi). A chain, but a good one.

backups.name: Griboyedov Canal behind Kazan Cathedral
backups.tips: A walk along the canal bank, in place of the garden.

stops.name: Palace Square
stops.tips: The Alexander Column and the General Staff arch, in front of the Winter Palace.

stops.name: State Hermitage Museum
stops.tips: The Winter Palace and 3 million works: Rembrandt, Da Vinci, the Raphael Loggias, and the Peacock Clock at 12:00. Book a timed ticket online; closed Mondays; allow 4 hours.

stops.name: Hermitage Cafeteria
stops.tips: The cafeteria inside the museum: a quick lunch without leaving.

stops.name: General Staff Building Hermitage
stops.tips: Impressionists (Monet, Matisse, Picasso), across the square. Combined ticket 1,400.

stops.name: Admiralty Embankment Walk
stops.tips: Along the Neva, with views of the Bronze Horseman and the dome of St Isaac's.

backups.name: Teremok Nevsky
backups.tips: A blini (crepe) chain: cheap and quick.

backups.name: Winter Palace of Peter I
backups.tips: Remains of Peter's first palace, instead of the General Staff Building.

stops.name: Peterhof Lower Park
stops.tips: The fountains are off from mid-October to April. In winter the park is free and the cascade statues are covered, so the palace is the main draw.

stops.name: Peterhof Grand Palace
stops.tips: Rastrelli's golden halls. Timed tickets; closed Mondays.

stops.name: Peterhof Shtandart Restaurant
stops.tips: A Russian restaurant next to the park: borscht and pelmeni.

stops.name: Alexandria Park Peterhof
stops.tips: The gulf shore in winter, with ice.

backups.name: Peterhof Bolshoy Cafe
backups.tips: A cheap cafe in the town.

backups.name: Monplaisir Palace
backups.tips: Peter's seaside pavilion, instead of Alexandria.

stops.name: Peter and Paul Fortress
stops.tips: The island where the city was born. The cathedral holds the Romanov tombs, the cannon fires at 12:00, and the beach gives a view of the city.

stops.name: Petrovsky Cafe in the Fortress
stops.tips: A cafe inside the fortress for lunch.

stops.name: Rostral Columns Strelka
stops.tips: The Vasilyevsky Island spit, with the columns and a panorama of the Neva.

stops.name: Kunstkamera
stops.tips: Peter's 1714 museum of curiosities. Closed Mondays.

stops.name: Vasilyevsky Lines Walk
stops.tips: Streets numbered as "lines", and the Andreyevsky market.

backups.name: Erarta Museum
backups.tips: Contemporary Russian art on Vasilyevsky Island, instead of the Kunstkamera.

stops.name: Catherine Palace
stops.tips: 45 minutes by train and bus or by taxi (Tsarskoye Selo). See the Amber Room and the Great Hall; timed tickets sell out online.

stops.name: Catherine Park
stops.tips: The park in winter: snow and ice on the lake.

stops.name: Podvorye Restaurant, Pushkin
stops.tips: Decorated like a Russian village house, and a restaurant Putin has eaten at. Blini and meat dishes.

stops.name: Alexander Palace
stops.tips: The last Tsar's home, with restored private rooms.

backups.name: Pavlovsk Palace
backups.tips: The neighbouring Pavlovsk palace and its huge park, instead of the Alexander Palace.

backups.name: Beliy Medved Cafe, Pushkin
backups.tips: Good value in the town centre.

stops.name: Saint Isaac's Cathedral
stops.tips: A huge golden dome. Climb the colonnade: 262 steps (extra charge) for a city panorama. Closed Wednesdays.

stops.name: Bronze Horseman
stops.tips: The statue of Peter the Great on Senate Square.

stops.name: Yusupov Palace
stops.tips: The palace where Rasputin was killed, with a private theatre and a basement scene. Audio guide.

stops.name: Sadko Restaurant Mariinsky
stops.tips: Russian cuisine next to the Mariinsky: a classic before the theatre.

stops.name: Neva and Canal Boat Tour
stops.tips: Daytime canal tour (May to October). In winter the canals are frozen; a bus tour is the alternative.

backups.name: Mariinsky Theatre
backups.tips: A ballet or opera evening. Buy tickets online weeks ahead (prices are higher for tourists).

days.theme: Summer Garden and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Summer Garden
stops.tips: In winter the statues are boxed up. Walk along the Neva.

stops.name: Fabergé Museum
stops.tips: Nine imperial eggs in the Shuvalov Palace, on the Fontanka.

stops.name: Yeliseyev Emporium
stops.tips: A luxury 1903 Art Nouveau food hall. Cake and champagne at the cafe corner; good for gifts.

stops.name: Moskovsky Station / Pulkovo Bus
stops.tips: To the airport: Moskovskaya metro plus bus 39, 60 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Cafe Singer Dom Knigi
backups.tips: A bookshop cafe with a view of Kazan Cathedral.

backups.name: Anna Akhmatova Museum
backups.tips: The poet's apartment in the Fountain House, instead of Fabergé.
